WITH fetched AS (
                SELECT
                    id,
                    cmd,
                    continue_on_error
                FROM command_queue
                WHERE device_id = $1
                  AND fetched = false
                  AND canceled = false
                  AND available_at <= now()
                ORDER BY id
                LIMIT $2
                FOR UPDATE
            ),
            marked AS (
                UPDATE command_queue
                SET fetched_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, fetched = true
                WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM fetched)
            )
            SELECT
                id AS "id!",
                cmd AS "cmd!",
                continue_on_error AS "continue_on_error!"
            FROM fetched
            ORDER BY id
